$comment: Hosts glaux-console refuses to send a request to. `suffixes` identify real AWS endpoints: full CRUD against production is designed out, not warned about. `blockedHosts` are cloud instance-metadata services — the console backend is a signing proxy, so letting the page name one of these would turn it into a credential-exfiltration hole. Link-local addresses (169.254.0.0/16, fe80::/10) are refused wholesale for the same reason. Shared by the browser-side endpoint form and the console backend, which enforces it.
